label: Screen Mockup
description: Screen Mockup como GRAFO (Fase 2, ver docs/architecture-nodes.md). Prueba que la tool se puede expresar como data + correr por el motor de nodos, al lado del handler viejo. scene(nano_image, pantalla verde) -> composite(nano_image_edit, encaja la UI en el verde).

inputs.name: ui_url
inputs.description: El screenshot de la UI del usuario (Fal URL).

inputs.name: scene_prompt
inputs.description: Prompt de la escena verde ya compuesto (greenScreenPrompt(escena)).

inputs.prompt: Image 1 is a photograph of a device with a solid green chroma-key screen. Image 2 is a user-interface screenshot. Replace ONLY the green screen area of the device in image 1 with the EXACT UI from image 2. Fit the UI precisely to the screen shape: correct perspective, rounded corners, edge-to-edge. Keep the UI pixel-faithful (identical layout, colors, text and elements — do not redraw or restyle it). Add subtle, realistic screen glare and reflection ON TOP of the UI. Do NOT change anything else in the photograph — the person, environment, lighting and device frame stay identical. Photorealistic result. Single clean photograph. No added captions, no watermark, no text overlay.
